name: dsh-native-subagents
title: Decide whether DSH should run Trellis role work as native sub-agents
description: After the 0.7.0-beta.4 upgrade lands, decide whether this repository should configure dsh as a dogfood platform so implement/check/research run as trellis-agent-* sub-agents instead of inline. Beta ships the three role prompts and the trellis_wait dispatch protocol, but the fork keeps dsh in the inline group and the repo has no .dsh/ tree, so the imported instructions currently point at skills that do not exist. Requires measuring the impact on the dogfood byte-parity regression and on .template-hashes.json before choosing.
creator: codex
